title: Endgame minute stats
description: Once a minute: observe panel status, confirm the run is not over, piggyback a gem-box check, OCR coins / coins-per-min / cash-per-min / diamonds, and append a spreadsheet row. Does not close the upgrade menu.
notes: Higher priority than the 15s buy tick. Currency toggle preset flips balances ↔ /min (playbook). Diamond ROI should stay readable in both modes. Disabled until ROIs are tuned. CSV: runs/endgame_stats.csv.

actions.description: Observe current panel status before stats OCR (open/closed + which tab).
Log which upgrade tab is showing during the stats pass.
Check the center dialog for end-of-run text before recording stats.
If the run ended, still log a final CSV row later; skip gem collect and rate toggles.
actions.explain_a: game over — skip gem tap and currency toggles; still write what we can
actions.explain_b: run active — gem check + currency OCR

on_a.message: minute stats: GAME OVER — final instrumentation pass
on_a.description: Flag that this minute row may be the last of the run.

actions.description: Same opportunistic gem-box check used on the buy tick (not a dedicated 10–15 min timer).
Collect gems if the box is visible during this OCR pass.
actions.explain_a: tap gem box via preset 'gem box tap'
actions.explain_b: no gem box — continue to stats

on_a.message: minute stats: gem box PRESENT — tapping

actions.description: Read the in-run wave for the CSV row.
Read coin balance (assumes HUD is in balances mode).
Read diamond / gem stock (playbook: stays stock across toggle).
Only toggle the currency HUD while the run is still up.
actions.explain_a: skip /min toggle — death dialog may cover the HUD
actions.explain_b: toggle to /min, OCR rates, toggle back to balances

on_a.message: minute stats: skipping currency toggle (game over)
on_a.description: Avoid clicking through the end-of-run dialog.

on_a.name: coins_per_min
on_a.description: Leave rates blank on the final row.

on_a.name: cash_per_min
on_a.description: Leave rates blank on the final row.

on_b.description: Fresh frame after the currency toggle so rate OCR is not stale.
Flip currency HUD back toward balances for the next buy tick.

actions.message: stats wave={wave_number} coins={coins} cpm={coins_per_min} cash/min={cash_per_min} diamonds={diamonds} game_over={game_over}
actions.description: Echo the parsed minute snapshot to the console.
Append datetime, run, wave, coins, coins/min, cash/min, diamonds, game_over to runs/endgame_stats.csv.
